Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and support scalable and highly available LAN, WAN, data center, cloud, and hybrid network environments. eligibility_evidence: This role provides technical leadership for network initiatives across on-premises, cloud, data center, and hybrid environments while ensuring reliability, security, scalability, and performance.
Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and support scalable and highly available LAN, WAN, data center, cloud, and hybrid network environments.
Implement and support Azure/cloud networking and hybrid connectivity solutions.
Strong experience with LAN/WAN, cloud networking, data center, SD-WAN, and hybrid environments.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Provide advanced technical expertise in BGP, OSPF, MPLS, SD-WAN, VXLAN/EVPN, VPN, QoS, firewalls, and load balancers. Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in enterprise networking and network security. Hands-on experience with Azure or other major cloud platforms. Preferred Certifications CCNP / CCIE or equivalent Microsoft Azure networking certifications AWS or Google Cloud networking certifications Other relevant networking or security certifications Our company complies with all local/state regulations in regard to displaying salary ranges.
